preparation.policy: Add this frozen measured warm preparation to each B/D endpoint. Cold indexing and machine charges are separate.

analysis.attribution: The combined policy and Sonnet briefing comparison pass their separate cost gates on this task. This does not establish a population-level interaction.

descriptive_cost_interaction.note: A ratio below one means the within-block briefing cost ratio is smaller on Sonnet. No significance or interaction gate was registered; failed-arm costs remain fixed-endpoint observations.

cost_accounting.note: Each cumulative CLI report is counted once. Unknown usage can make these sums lower bounds. No costs from previous task panels are pooled.
